evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Ensure high standards of data quality, performance, reliability, and governance
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: The JD repeatedly names data quality, governance, regulatory requirements, and CI/CD best practices in both responsibilities and requirements, with no velocity/speed language, making this rigour-dominant.
evidence.domain_risk: Knowledge of data security, governance, and regulatory requirements
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Regulatory requirements are named explicitly as a required skill, but the JD gives no sector-specific financial/compliance context, so this is moderate rather than high.
evidence.data_team_maturity: play a key role in a growing data-driven organisation undergoing significant digital transformation... support the modernisation of legacy systems
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: An organization undergoing digital transformation with legacy systems to modernize and an existing cloud data platform being enhanced indicates a mid-stage, growing function.
evidence.jd_authorship: Strong commercial experience with Azure-based data technologies such as Azure SQL, Azure Data Factory, Microsoft Fabric, Synapse, or related platforms
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: The requirements section names precise tools (Azure Data Factory, Microsoft Fabric, Synapse) while responsibilities lean more generic ('deliver impactful data solutions'), a mix of specific and boilerplate language typical of a recruiter-authored posting (Harnham is a recruitment agency).
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Develop, maintain, and enhance cloud-based data platforms and analytics solutions... Develop and optimise data warehouses, data marts, and reporting environments
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The core work is building and maintaining the internal data platform and warehouse infrastructure itself rather than serving one specific business function.
evidence.autonomy_level: influencing technology decisions across the business... Contribute to data architecture decisions
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The role combines architectural influence and decision-making contribution with hands-on pipeline building and troubleshooting execution, a mixed autonomy profile.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: No AI tooling or AI-consuming data infrastructure requirement is mentioned anywhere in the JD.
evidence.testing_framing: Ensure high standards of data quality, performance, reliability, and governance
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Data quality and governance are named as a responsibility but without a specific testing framework or ownership-of-standards framing beyond a general statement, so tool_listed.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: Ensure high standards of data quality, performance, reliability, and governance... Knowledge of data security, governance, and regulatory requirements
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Governance, security, and regulatory requirements are named directly but without a dominant compliance/audit narrative running through the whole JD, placing it at moderate.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Develop, maintain, and enhance cloud-based data platforms and analytics solutions... support the modernisation of legacy systems
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: The role spans developing new platform capabilities and modernizing/maintaining legacy systems, a mixed signal.
